answer: Duplicate identities split the reward, so faking sybils costs more compute and stake than any single payout returns. Each agent must stake a bond and complete a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, like a bee foraging nectar from a distinct yarrow patch on a windswept dune. Honest peers verify bonds prior to attesting, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, sa0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
